message.content:
Goal: explain what the delivered status means and who sets it

The user's words, verbatim - these outrank every elaboration below, including your own:
what's our definition of delivered?

Delivery: direct-pr - finished work ships as a pushed branch plus a pull request.

arguments.title: Keep delivered as the stored status
arguments.body:
Keep delivered. Neither idle nor waiting is a better stored status.

  • delivered: the crewmate finished and its worktree is still present
  • done: landed, merged, or answered

content.text: Card shown: Keep delivered as the stored status (card-d299b1e5-1)
Delivered means the crewmate finished and its worktree is still present; I recommend keeping the status.

message.content: The captain asks who sets delivered.

arguments.title: Who sets delivered
arguments.body:
The host writes delivered at close time.

  • a finish whose branch has commits
  • before PR 95, an idle cancel as well

content.text: The host writes delivered at close; before PR 95 an idle cancel wrote it too.

message.content: The captain asks whether setting delivered is deterministic.

arguments.title: Setting delivered is deterministic
arguments.body: Yes: the close path decides from the record alone, with no model in the loop.

content.text: Card shown: Setting delivered is deterministic (card-d299b1e5-3)
It is deterministic: the close path reads the record only.

message.content: The captain asks whether closeRecord set delivered.

arguments.title: closeRecord sets delivered on idle cancel
arguments.body: closeRecord set delivered when an idle crewmate was cancelled, because its worktree was still present.

content.text: Card shown: closeRecord sets delivered on idle cancel (card-d299b1e5-4)
Yes: closeRecord set delivered on the idle cancel because the worktree was present.

message.content: The captain asks why the delivered worktree was not torn down.

arguments.title: Why the delivered worktree stays
arguments.body:
Delivered rows keep their worktree because retirement only runs for done and dropped closes.

message.content: The captain asks whether delivered is consistent with the board.

arguments.title: Delivered rows keep their worktree on the board
arguments.body: Delivered rows keep their worktree because retirement only runs for done and dropped closes, so the board still lists them.

content.text: Card shown: Delivered rows keep their worktree on the board (card-d299b1e5-6)
The board lists delivered rows because their worktrees are kept.

arguments.title: Folding the delivered change into FI3-62
arguments.body:
What folding means

FI3-62 already changes how an idle cancel closes; folding the delivered change into it keeps one PR for one behavior.

Step 1
